I am an old man now, 77 years, and I have farmed this land in Mulanje all my life. This maize plot is small but it feeds my household, so I must use fertilizer if I can get the subsidy coupon — without it the soil here is tired and the maize will not grow tall. I keep some chickens and goats, so I spread their manure on the plot before the rains come, and I buy hybrid seed from the ADMARC because the local seed does not yield enough anymore. My legs are weak, so my children and grandchildren help me with the hoeing and weeding, and when the weeding is heavy I pay a few young men from the village for piece work (ganyu).
